title: toasts scope mini zoom and panel polish

commit.merge_subject: merge: toasts scope mini zoom and panel polish

description:
Two visual refinements from the owner add-on (2026-11-12):

Squircle sheet edges: the portrait EditorPanelSheet now draws 28dp top
corners, per the DESIGN.md M3 shape scale ("bottom sheets 28dp top
corners"). The radius is the stock M3 extraLarge (28dp), built top-only
because the sheet's bottom sits flush against the navigation bar, and
portrait-only (the landscape sheet is a full-height pane). The shape is
painted with Modifier.background rather than a Surface shape param:
Surface(shape) clips content and bounds pointer hit-testing, which would
kill the handle's collapsed-state overhang. The Surface->Box swap keeps
the contentColor contract via CompositionLocalProvider(LocalContentColor
provides contentColorFor(sheetColor)), so text and icon colors are
unchanged.

Handle margin trim: the collapsed anchor drops 48dp -> 36dp (25% less
strip), while the handle's 48dp touch target is prese
